# Slop phrase seed list
#
# Source: sam-paech/antislop-sampler, slop_phrase_prob_adjustments.json (MIT).
#   https://github.com/sam-paech/antislop-sampler/blob/main/slop_phrase_prob_adjustments.json
# Retrieved verbatim 2026-08-27. These are the first ~150 entries of that file, which is
# "mostly auto-generated by computing over-represented words in a large LLM-generated story
# dataset" (repo README).
#
# This is a SEED, not the list. The full file holds thousands of entries, and Antislop's paper
# reports suppressing 8000+ patterns (arXiv 2510.15061). To use the full list see data/README.md.
#
# Do not hand-edit additions into this file. Over-representation is measured against a human
# baseline; intuition about what "sounds like AI" does not reproduce it. Put project-specific
# bans in the story's StyleContract.forbidden_phrases instead.
#
# Lines beginning with # are ignored. Leading/trailing spaces in an entry are significant in
# the source file and preserved here.
